title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
authors: Rosenfeld, Gidney, Roberts, Morvan, et al.
conversion_notes: Compare each stim_X.stim or stim_Z.stim against the corresponding serialized cirq_circuit_X/Z.json: restore the original non-Clifford rotations in place of the Clifford substitutions; account for echo and conjugate tags and frame changes. Determine exact angles and locations from Cirq; do not blindly replace every S. Reconsider detector/observable determinism after restoration.
notes: Google Quantum AI experimental dataset states explicitly that Stim circuits replace non-Cliffords with Clifford gates and includes original Cirq circuits. The three figure archives total 3.2 GB and were not downloaded. Superconducting cultivation and grafting; experimental circuit rather than generic theoretical layout.

title: Constant-depth magic state cultivation with Clifford measurements by gauging
conversion_notes: The paper's logical XS-dagger gauging projects toward a magic state using Clifford operations; inspect the state preparation and notebook before adding a non-Clifford operation, and compare to physical protocol. The separately bundled cultivation_stim_circuits are Gidney benchmark circuits, not necessarily the paper's gauging circuit.
notes: Paper names author repository, which redirects to IBM repo; color_code.py builds stim.Circuit and escape_stage.py builds surface-code deformation. Supplement discusses heavy-hex color-code layouts; simulated main protocol uses square connectivity. README incorrectly gives unrelated arXiv:2510.05225; the paper itself confirms this repo.

title: Efficient Magic State Cultivation on RP^2
conversion_notes: Inspect injection and logical verification gadgets in rp_3_T_cult.stim and generator t_gadget.py; identify proxy |Y> preparations and S/S_DAG rotations that stand in for T and T_DAG, and replace only those. Do not globally replace all S gates. Preserve conditional operations and recheck observable semantics.
notes: Repository contains d=3/d=5 cultivation and end-to-end .stim files plus Python sampling/generator code. Uses RP^2 self-dual codes with nonlocal connectivity suitable for neutral-atom or ion architectures. Precise target lines not independently verified.

title: Efficient Magic State Cultivation on the Surface Code

Exact replacement locations require inspection.
notes: Repository identifies simulation.py generators, Clifford Stim and Sinter simulations, plus separate full-state-vector simulations. Circuit files are generated by scripts; do not assume tracked circuits exist.

title: Magic State Injection with Erasure Qubits
conversion_notes: Locate the injection-state placeholder, e.g. replace |Y> preparation or its Clifford proxy with the proper |T> preparation, or restore hook-injection T rotations. For cultivation examine Gidney-derived surrogate S/S_DAG gadget operations before substitution. Erasure simulation may require extra handling beyond an ordinary Pauli-noise Stim sampler.
notes: Author data and scripts on Zenodo (248 MB zip; not downloaded); Stim's circuit-reference catalog independently identifies Stim circuits in the release. Paper compares center-qubit injection, hook injection, and color-code cultivation under heralded erasures. Exact gate mapping unverified.

title: Simulating magic state cultivation with few Clifford terms
conversion_notes: The released Python file includes a Stim-like circuit string with T_DAG (e.g. T_DAG 13 in the injection block). Extract and concatenate the relevant circuit blocks as directed by run.py; these extended instructions are not accepted by ordinary Stim. No proxy replacement needed for those native gate strings.
notes: Companion repository explicitly targets Tsim and exact non-Clifford d=3 cultivation; the paper studies d=5. This repo's d=3 workload is related but should not be confused with a verified release of the paper's d=5 benchmark.
